head: claude/mi154b-scalp-artifact-20260907-land
title: MI-154b: publish the 5m/15m ict_scalp exit-head artifacts (shadow) and record what is still unobserved
body:
## Read both halves — they are different facts

**DONE.** Two `ict_scalp`-family exit-head artifacts are trained, exported and **published to the trainer mirror at `stage: shadow`**. The lane's *data* half is finished.

**NOT DONE.** The briefed done-condition — *artifact visible on `/api/diag/shadow_stats` AND the guard observed admitting a real `ict_scalp` leg (`decision_state` other than `not_scored`)* — **is not met, and could not have been met by publishing.** It is blocked on #11140. I am reporting that rather than implying a soak is accruing.

## What was published

Built with the **existing** `scripts/ml/export_exit_head.py` — no parallel exporter — using the `--family` flag #11169 merged for exactly this. Both report `family='ict_scalp' (declared)` at export time, the provenance line #11169 added.

| model_id | family | tf | stage | symbols | train_rows | train_trades |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `exit-head-ict_scalp-5m-v1` | `ict_scalp` | `5m` | `shadow` | AVAX, SOL, XRP | 70 891 | 3 950 |
| `exit-head-ict_scalp-15m-v1` | `ict_scalp` | `15m` | `shadow` | ETH, SOL, XRP | 28 683 | 1 678 |

Both boosters load: 300 trees, 14 features, matching the 14 declared. **POPULATION for training rows: the whole pooled dataset, asserted 100% `source == "harness"` before training** (70891/70891, 28683/28683) — the exporter silently drops non-harness rows, so an unasserted pool trains on an unknown denominator. Mirror population read back after the write: **2 → 4**. Nothing promoted past `shadow`.

## ⛔ Why the done-condition was unreachable — verified here, not inherited

My predecessor recorded this ordering argument; I re-verified every load-bearing claim independently rather than trusting it. All hold.

- **`decision_state` appears in 0 `.py` files** on `main` `0ec62fc0`. *Positive control:* the same probe over `EXIT_LOOP_DECOUPLE_DISABLED` → **4 files**. It is introduced by #11140, so the condition cannot be evaluated against deployed code.
- **The only `maybe_score_exit_head` call site is `trend_donchian.py:802`.** The `ict_scalp` unit has none. POPULATION: all 55 strategies in `config/strategies.yaml`; all 8 `ict_scalp` legs are 5m/15m.
- **`shadow_stats` enumerates models that SCORED, not artifacts that exist** — `shadow.py::stats` aggregates `shadow_predictions.jsonl` via `iter_records(log)`. An artifact never scored writes no rows and can never appear there.

**Confirmed by observation after publishing.** `/api/diag/shadow_stats`, POPULATION **32 model_ids**, positive control finds both donchian ids: **`ict_scalp` models on the feed = 0**, unchanged. Exactly as the three mechanisms predict.

## No hazard was created — checked, not assumed

The open item warns that publishing before the family gate could convert a latent gap into a live one. It did not. The guard's first filter is an **exact `tf` match**, so a 5m/15m artifact can only ever be offered to a leg itself on 5m/15m. POPULATION: all 55 strategies → **11 are on 5m/15m** — the 8 `ict_scalp` legs plus `turtle_soup`, `vwap`, `fvg_range_15m`. Those three each have **their own module with their own `monitor()` and no `maybe_score_exit_head` call**, and no `trend_donchian` leg is on 5m/15m. So no 5m/15m leg can reach the scorer at all — which is both why nothing scores and why nothing out-of-family can be scored.

## Delivery is inferred, not observed — stated rather than glossed

Artifacts written `04:14:45Z`; a full mirror rsync completed **`04:16:27Z`, strictly after** (the `04:14:26` run predates the write and did not carry them). `publish_trainer_mirror.sh` ships the `exit_head` dir and logs `status: published` to the live VM. **But `trainer_mirror/exit_head` is not on the diag allowlist** (`exit_head` and `trainer_mirror` each appear 0 times in `diag.py`), so the destination cannot be read. The channel has a positive control — the two donchian heads arrived by this exact path — but this specific delivery is an inference.

## What is missing, precisely

1. **#11140 must merge** (open, unmerged, tier 3, manager-held). It adds the call site, `ICT_SCALP_EXIT_HEAD_MODE`, `exit_head_apply.py` and `decision_state`.
2. **Then these artifacts are consumed with no further work** — the guard matches `tf` + `symbols`, and these cover **6 of the 8** `ict_scalp` legs. #11140 also adds the `family` check; both artifacts declare `ict_scalp`, which is in its `_ACCEPTED_FAMILIES`.
3. **Not covered:** `ict_scalp_5m` (BTCUSDT, `blocked:data_missing_btcusdt`) and `ict_scalp_mgc_15m` (`blocked:native-history-thin`). Neither symbol is in a published `symbols` list, so the guard fail-closes rather than scoring out of distribution.

⚠️ **Nothing here argues for arming.** `ICT_SCALP_EXIT_HEAD_MODE` untouched, no leg declares `exit_head_action`, no coverage-matrix cell `status` edited — all Tier-3. The 2026-08-23 `SHIP BLOCKED` verdict is untouched; its precondition (a consumer in the `ict_scalp` unit) is still unmet. `ict_scalp_eth_15m` remains a recorded `honest_negative` and `ict_scalp_sol_5m`'s pass does not survive re-partitioning; their symbols are included deliberately so those legs can accrue shadow evidence, but **a shadow artifact existing is not evidence either should be armed**, and the pooled head has had no E1.5 validation of its own pooled shape.

## Relay bug found and filed, not walked past

`trainer-diag-relay.yml`'s commit-back is `git push origin HEAD:<ref>` under `set -euo pipefail` with **no rebase and no retry**. `board-post.yml` ran on the same push, committed first, and the relay's push became a non-fast-forward — so a result it had already computed on the trainer was **discarded**. It presents as an absent result file, indistinguishable from "never ran" and "trainer down"; it cost ~25 min of misdiagnosis. Filed as `BL-20260907-TRAINER-DIAG-RELAY-DISCARDS-A-COMPUTED-RESULT-ON-A-PUSH-RACE`.

## Landing

`tier: 1 / self`. Guards run, not reasoned: `pr-landing: OK — state=declared_self_land`, `stated-population-guard: OK`, `open-items-guard: OK — 60 items`.

The diff is 5 files, all on the Tier-1 surface. The `automation/**` relay scaffolding is deliberately **not** in this PR — that path is absent from `TIER1_SURFACE`, so including it would make the diff unvouchable; narrowing is the guard's own first-listed remedy and the one #11169 took for `scripts/ml/**`. It stays on `claude/mi154b-scalp-artifact-20260907`, and its measurements are quoted verbatim in the memo.

The `OPEN-ITEMS.json` row is **re-affirmed, not cleared** — `verified_at` bumped and an observation appended saying which half of part (3) is done. 60 items before and after. The pre-stage is recorded as a **decision**, exactly as that row requires.
